says: In next/, two hands clients started with the same key both run the same job: a take from any connection of the target key answers the first assignment again, and a repeated jobs.started answers ok, so each client, with its own journal, saves executing and runs the command.
proof: job.ts:86 answers a take of an assigned job with REPEATED whatever executor the second take proposed, and gateway/Jobs.ts answers it as assigned with the first execution; JobAccess.owns checks the key, the process and the execution, never the connection, so the second client's jobs.started and jobs.finish are accepted too.
cost: A command meant to run once runs twice, on two machines, whenever a person copies a key or starts the hands twice.
